results.changed: Internal doublet transport in a fixed endpoint registration; full common-doublet SU2 is no longer preserved.
results.gauge: The entire dressed global generator is unitarily conjugate to the undressed one by a witness-dependent fiber frame. Transforming endpoint frames as well makes it a coordinate change.
results.marginal_nonclosure: psi+=(|0,0>+i|255,255>)/sqrt2 and psi- with minus sign have identical marginals and witness0 currents +/-sqrt42*kappa.

results.preserved: All address norm fractions, exact write time, 30th-order witness retention, locality, positivity, SU6 and total face moments.
results.product_reduction: The positive quartic product restriction of Audit008 traps P in seven approach/capture sites and W in {0,255}; witness488 stays exactly zero for all time.
results.product_scope: Scalar address factors with a common fixed internal vector, the same 25 local terms and the original preparation. Not a no-go for every independent V-valued field model.
results.selection_boundary: The native Pa is recovered; attaching it to this particular G9000 bond is a declared comparison, not a derived native coupling or a bit identification.
results.shared_native_carrier: Both source branches contain byte-identical Field-Invariants001 and the same native J.
results.tree_boundary: The prepared component has no cycles. An open-path internal residual is not by itself a nontrivial closed-loop holonomy.
